blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A concerned citizen helped foil an attempted bank robbery in Rosario, Batangas, on Sunday, with the arrest of an armed man who allegedly broke into a branch of the Philippine National Bank (PNB). In a report on Monday, the Batangas Police Provincial Office (BPPO) said police were tipped off about a man allegedly attempting to force open the bank’s glass door in Barangay Poblacion C at 5:15 p.m. Patrolling police officers responded, found the door lock broken, and the suspect inside the bank.
